## Why

Wave-B batch `r11-documents-01` (`27 7 23 * *`, create-paused) — the fourteen-candidate ACQ-15 family lands as **twelve registry rows** (all reconciled in place from the ACQ-01 generated ids to the I8 §5.8 design ids — `Proposed id` kept in each note, `Reconciled id` recorded) plus **two widen targets** under the already-flipped `openstates` source (`openstates_plan.toml` `[[pinned_bill_queries]]`, no new source row, no new rights line). Six grant records emit `grant_award`-family facts (recipient agency, amount, purpose literal, programme, instrument, date); three council/agenda documents emit `enacting_body`/`citation`/`authorization_state` + `vendor`/`contract_value` facts; two procurement notices emit `procurement_notice` `contract_number`/`buyer` facts; the Guam governor's page emits publication facts for Bill 132-35 under RB-06. Procured is never deployed; a proposed bill is never enacted law.

## What ships

- **Twelve gated sources wired** (`sources.toml`, 587 registered — net zero on the in-place renames; all `ingestion_permitted=false`, rights UNDETERMINED, `review_packet`/`rights_note` verbatim terms carried): `grant_tx_txdmv_mvcpa`, `grant_ca_bscc_ort`, `grant_fl_senate_lfir`, `grant_al_adeca_psn`, `grant_nj_oag_bwc`, `grant_ok_dac_jag_lle` (grants); `agenda_haskell_ar_council`, `agenda_des_moines_ia_council`, `agenda_jasper_sc_council` (council/agenda); `procportal_davie_fl_purchasing`, `procportal_forsyth_nc_purchasing` (procurement portals); `legis_gu_governor` (Guam, RB-06). The twelve generated-id `promote` disposition placeholders are removed — a connector-mapped source carries no disposition row.
- **`dossier_field_crosswalk.toml`** — seven additive reviewed grant/procurement field rows (`grant_recipient`→`recipient`, `grant_funder`→`funder`, `grant_program`→`funding_program_name`, `award_instrument`→`funding_instrument`, `award_date`→`award_date`, `item_description`→`description`, `contract_number`→`contract_number`) — all existing ontology predicates; no amendment needed, none recorded ad-hoc.
- **`dossier_documents_vocab.toml`** — twelve `[adapters.*]` blocks (jurisdiction scope + reviewed predicate allowlists; `disclosure_field_state` on every block for the mandated-≠-populated record; no person predicate anywhere).
- **`live_targets.toml`** — one `clause_fields` target per new source: the published document URL + field-bound literals reviewed against the drift rules (`absent`/`redacted`/`answered` states; the OK JAG-LLE page carries a reviewed-`absent` `funding_amount` — a recorded field-state, never fabricated).
- **`openstates_plan.toml`** — `plan_version` 2026.09.18 → 2026.10.14; `[[pinned_bill_queries]]` ×2: AZ HB 2574 (`56th-2nd-regular` — the completed session the current-window rule never reaches, pinned verbatim) and NY S7037 (`2025-2026`). Pinned rows generate the same bounded `bill_search` target shape inside `max_queries`, carry `pinned_bill` provenance onto the `bill_query` outcome row, and keep verbatim local match attribution — the fuzzy v3 search is never trusted as the match.
